node.statement: Under the respective Stage-1 producer hypotheses, write the raw-call scale as t=t_1=W.K1*epsilon, with 0<=t<=W.r_reset and epsilon<=W.e1/W.K1. The construction certified by lem-maincb-stage1-call-envelope, using lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement, furnishes the literal u_1:C^{m+1}->A as an extended D_1*t-inclusion and gives ||u_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A||<=D_1*t. Since D_1*t<=D_*t, lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone and scalar transitivity give the asserted extended D_*t-inclusion and unit bound for the same literal map and amplification family.
